adjusted_prescription: To set up a complex network with multiple VLANs, start by configuring each VLAN on your network devices to segment traffic properly. Next, enable inter-VLAN routing so that devices on different VLANs can communicate securely and efficiently. Apply security policies, such as access control lists, to regulate traffic between VLANs and protect sensitive information. Use scripting tools to automate these configurations for consistency and ease of deployment. Finally, validate your setup using network monitoring tools to ensure routing is working as expected and security policies are being enforced, preventing errors and maintaining a coordinated multi-device environment. This approach helps create a reliable and secure network topology with thorough end-to-end verification.
